bullets: Led sales and the candidate receives RM 18,000 per month in client fees.
expect: Led sales and the candidate receives RM 18,000 per month in client fees.
cases.note: Explicit business receipts remain work, not candidate salary.

bullets: Analysed performance and company earnings are RM 18,000 monthly.
expect: Analysed performance and company earnings are RM 18,000 monthly.

bullets: Analysed her earnings of RM 18,000 monthly for the client.
expect: Analysed her earnings of RM 18,000 monthly for the client.
cases.note: A possessive object of a work verb is not an independent candidate-pay subject.

bullets: Managed sales and the candidate receives RM 9,000 p.a. in client fees.
expect: Managed sales and the candidate receives RM 9,000 p.a. in client fees.
cases.note: An annual abbreviation cannot hide the explicit business-receipts qualifier.
